base_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a production texture atlas for Reverie, an original surreal storytelling card game. Create ONE portrait 2:3 image in a perfectly regular TWO COLUMN by TWO ROW grid of FOUR DIFFERENT original illustrations. High resolution ideally 2048x3072. Each quadrant itself is a portrait 2:3 image; exact equal quadrants, boundaries at 50% of width and height. FULL BLEED, ZERO gutters, no borders, no text, no numbers, no letters, no logos. No object crosses quadrant boundaries. Rich evocative narrative compositions with multiple poetic interpretations. Exquisite surreal storybook painting in luminous gouache and watercolor, delicate painterly texture, expressive shapes, beautiful warm/cool contrast, readable focal subjects, sophisticated but gentle, varied palettes. Entirely original art: do not reproduce any existing game card, branded character, artist's signature, or existing illustration. Scene positions are strictly top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right; this image is an atlas addressed by UV coordinates.
